query: SELECT cm.id as moduleId, cm.title as moduleName, COUNT(cl.id) as lessonCount, ROUND(AVG(LENGTH(cl.content))) as avgLength, MIN(LENGTH(cl.content)) as minLength, MAX(LENGTH(cl.content)) as maxLength, SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(cl.content) < 7000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as substandard_count FROM course_modules cm JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id, cm.title ORDER BY avgLength ASC;
